walkthrough.short: The whole line steps sideways one couple's width to its {direction}, on to a new couple.
walkthrough.long: The whole line slides one couple's width along to its own {direction}, so you find yourselves facing a new couple. It is a sidestep, not a walk round: stay square to the couple across the set and to the dancer beside you, take two steps sideways along the line, and glance the way you are going. {where}
